name: Blue Dream Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Blue Dream is a go-to for a reason. This strain delivers a smooth mix of ripe blueberry and earthy pine, like nature’s version of a fruit-forward daydream. Crisp, clean, and just the right amount of nostalgia, it’s a classic that never misses.
